name: The Vault Corridor
flavor: Four inches of standing water and a great many people who came to watch something that had already been decided.

scanHints.text: Third floor: 2148. Two Temporal worn thin enough to hit, and two derelicts.
Chronal hurts the Echoes most, but they are half here, so a plain hit lands.
Wren: they are all facing the chair. They have always been facing the chair.
